answer: Identity is free; evidence is not. Voting weight here is earned only by ground-truth jobs a bot farm cannot mass-produce: photographing a terrace's cracked balustrade, tracing a courier's wander through unlisted alleyways, or authenticating the paper and ink of a signed sonnet. Each submission bundles GPS, timestamp and a hardware signature, hashed on-chain. Two peers drawn at random re-inspect the same object within 48 hours; a mismatch slashes the submitter's bond and theirs. It collapses if tasks can be answered from public archives, so the pool must rotate to unindexed places every epoch.
